TRPS1 was successfully immunoprecipitated in all three cell lines, confirming the validity of the experiment and the specificity of the TRPS1 antibody. TRPS1 was identified to interact with several components of the NuRD and coREST complexes and this result was consistent in all three cell lines and between replicates.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments described (RIME) are interactome mapping studies (affinity purification) rather than differential perturbation studies. While the paper contains siRNA screens and RNA-seq with perturbations, the MS data (PXD010312) specifically relates to the identification of protein interactors for ER, TRPS1, and ZNF217. Therefore, it is classified as 'un-classified' as it does not present a differential treatment axis.
